relationships.subject: streptozotocin
relationships.evidence_quote: WB results showed that STZ injection significantly increased the expressions of p-PKC, TRPV1, SP, and CGRP in the L4-L6 DRGs on 1 W, 2 W, and 3 W

relationships.subject: electroacupuncture
relationships.evidence_quote: EA treatment downregulated p-PKC and TRPV1 expression

relationships.subject: electroacupuncture
relationships.evidence_quote: EA reversed thermal hyperalgesia in DNP rats and downregulated the expression of p-PKC, TRPV1, SP, and CGRP in DRG and SCDH.

relationships.subject: TRPV1
relationships.evidence_quote: The findings showed that CGRP was coexpressed with TRPV1 in DRG cells

key_findings: STZ-induced diabetic neuropathic pain increased p-PKC, TRPV1, SP and CGRP in DRG and spinal dorsal horn.
2 Hz electroacupuncture reversed thermal hyperalgesia and reduced these markers.
